insight.title: The Developer Who Slowed the Software to Increase Trust
insight.subtitle: Why making a process slower increased customer satisfaction

sections.text: The development team spent months optimizing their mortgage calculator. It became so efficient that it delivered complex financial results in less than a hundredth of a second.
Users hated it. They didn't believe the math was accurate because it happened instantly. Trust plummeted, and customers abandoned the tool before ever completing their loan applications.
The lead developer added a five-second animation of a spinning wheel. He labeled it "Analyzing Market Data." No code changed, but user trust and sales instantly doubled.
Credibility often requires the illusion of effort.
